Women’s Faith Formation meets Tuesday, April 21 from 7:00–8:30 PM in Zwisler Hall, and the Peace Together Choir celebrates its 25th anniversary with a concert on Sunday, April 26 at 4:00 PM followed by a reception. Mark your calendar for May Crowning and a Marian procession on Sunday, May 3 after the 9:00 AM Mass (with Donut Sunday in Zwisler Hall).
